catalog.notes: NO vendor catalog exists: SNI Tunnel is a generic V2Ray client (Flutter + xray Go core). No provider URL in DEX, libapp.so (Dart AOT) or libgojni.so. SNI_Tunnel.py fetches ANY user-supplied subscription URL exactly as the app does (GET, UA SNI-Tunnel/1.3.0 (Android), x-hwid, HTTPS only, manual redirects max 5, 16 MB limit, subscription-userinfo header) and parses vmess/vless/trojan/ss/hy2/hysteria2/tuic/socks links or Clash YAML plus # key: value provider directives. Mechanism verified against a local server 17/17; self-test 34/34. No live vendor catalog to version.
